# Minimum carbon-beam model interface for the currently gated geometry
#
# This file provides the geometry and baseline source interface. In BASELINE
# mode, beam/plan_generated.txt overrides energy, spot position, spot sigma and
# histories for every DICOM spot. In COMMISSIONED mode, the same generated file
# disables PlanCarbonBeam and defines one Emittance source per active energy
# layer using the imported machine model.

includeFile = beam/MRF4.txt

# Moving source frame. PlanBeamPosition is placed upstream of isocenter by the
# case geometry generator and its local +Z points along patient -X. For the
# currently gated G90/HFS mapping:
#   DICOM IEC GANTRY X -> patient +Y -> PlanBeamPosition local +Y
#   DICOM IEC GANTRY Y -> patient +Z -> PlanBeamPosition local +X
# plan_generated.txt therefore swaps the two DICOM spot coordinates when it
# assigns the local translations. The signs are preserved.
s:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/Type = "Group"
s:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/Parent = "PlanBeamPosition"
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/TransX = 0. mm
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/TransY = 0. mm
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/TransZ = 0. mm
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/RotX = 0. deg
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/RotY = 0. deg
d:Ge/PlanSpotPosition/RotZ = 0. deg

# Static source definition. The generated plan supplies all per-spot values.
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/Type = "Beam"
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/Component = "PlanSpotPosition"
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamParticle = "GenericIon(6,12,6)"

# Disabled fallback values, overridden by plan_generated.txt. TOPAS BeamEnergy
# is the ion's TOTAL kinetic energy, so the generator uses 12 * Energy_MeV/u.
d:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamEnergy = 1. MeV
i:So/PlanCarbonBeam/NumberOfHistoriesInRun = 0

# DICOM ScanningSpotSize is FWHM in air at isocenter. The generator converts
# it to standard deviation: sigma = FWHM / (2*sqrt(2*ln(2))).
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionDistribution = "Gaussian"
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionCutoffShape = "Ellipse"
d:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionSpreadX = 1. mm
d:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionSpreadY = 1. mm
# 40 mm exceeds 6 sigma for the largest DICOM spot (sigma = 6.078 mm), so this
# numerical tail guard does not represent an aperture or commissioning datum.
d:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionCutoffX = 40. mm
d:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamPositionCutoffY = 40. mm

# UNCOMMISSIONED PLACEHOLDERS used only by BASELINE mode:
# - 0% energy sigma means monoenergetic, not a measured clinical spectrum.
# - None means no random angular divergence and parallel nominal spot axes.
# Do not use this baseline for clinical-range/dose claims.
u:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamEnergySpread = 0.
s:So/PlanCarbonBeam/BeamAngularDistribution = "None"

# DICOM VirtualSourceAxisDistances describe apparent field projection, but do
# not supply random emittance or the energy-dependent phase-space correlations
# needed for a commissioned source.
# The case geometry generator records the selected source plane. Commissioned
# mode places it at the validated phase-space plane and uses DICOM VSAD to steer
# each nominal spot axis; the VSAD is not used as random emittance.
